summary: Iteration 81 - Install Issue Bug Fix Verification. Tested service worker registration, install prompt fallback UX, support center troubleshooting cards, and landing page install CTAs. CRITICAL FIX APPLIED: Deleted legacy /service-worker.js file that was blocking new /sw.js registration. All install-related UI components working correctly.

action_items: CRITICAL: Legacy /service-worker.js file was deleted - this should fix install issues for users who clear cache or use new browsers
NOTE: Existing users with cached legacy service worker may need to manually clear browser data or wait for cache expiry
RECOMMENDATION: Add a version check in App.js to force unregister legacy SW more aggressively if still detected
critical_code_review_comments: The legacy /service-worker.js file should have been deleted when /sw.js was introduced - this was the root cause of install failures
App.js cleanup logic for legacy SW was correct but ineffective because the file was still being served
test_credentials: No credentials required for public route tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 81 fixed the install blocker by deleting the legacy /service-worker.js file. The new /sw.js is now active. All install prompt fallback UX for iOS/Android/in-app browsers is working. Support Center troubleshooting cards are comprehensive. CDN may still serve cached legacy SW temporarily.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Legacy /service-worker.js file was still present in /app/frontend/public/ and being served with 200 status, causing browsers to continue using the old service worker instead of the new /sw.js
reproduction_steps: 3. App.js tries to unregister legacy SW and register /sw.js
4. But /service-worker.js still returns 200, so browser may re-register it
5. Install prompt fails because SW is in inconsistent state
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Deleted /app/frontend/public/service-worker.js so it returns 404, forcing browsers to use /sw.js exclusively
